title: School Secretary
format: Actual application screen captures with fictional isolated demo records; no live authentication, native installation or reconnect sync verification
voice: User-selected English voice-02; not a verified Nigerian-English accent

scenes.label: School link & sign-in
scenes.narration: Open your school's branded link. Staff and parents use their registered phone and four-digit PIN. This recording uses fictional demo records and a local session, not live authentication.

scenes.label: Admissions & guardian links
scenes.narration: Choose Students, search the demo roster and open a learner record. Review the admission details and guardian phone. Link siblings carefully; never give one family access to another learner.

scenes.label: Attendance & authorised classes
scenes.narration: Choose Attendance and check the class and date. Review the summary and open the attendance sheet preview. The secretary uses authorised records, not owner settings or teacher score editing.

scenes.label: Read-only A4 report printing
scenes.narration: Return to Students and open a report card. Check the same fixed A four page on either device. Print only reports your role is allowed to access and follow the school publication process.

scenes.label: School app guidance
scenes.narration: Open your school's link and choose Install school app. The real help dialog explains Safari and Chrome steps. A native installation is not being verified here.

scenes.label: Offline boundaries & privacy
scenes.narration: Sign in online and open needed records before offline work. Attendance and score drafts can sync when reconnected; review conflicts. Payments, messages and new sign-ins need internet. This demo does not verify live sync. Keep school links and family records private.
